Title: Azure Sentinel generally available in Azure Government

Body.Content:
Microsoft Azure Sentinel, is a cloud-native SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) that provides intelligent security analytics for the entire enterprise. 

Azure Sentinel has been Generally available for commercial customers since September 2019.  Azure Sentinel is now generally available in Azure Government, starting with US Gov Virginia region.

Get more information on availability and pricing for Azure Government regions

Learn More
